incidents.title: Kerala man loses ₹40k to AI-enabled deep-fake fraud
incidents.confidenceReason: The AI claim is hedged at its source: the scamster "police believe" used deep-fake technology, and the victim says only that the caller "looked exactly like my former colleague". A hedged claim is Suspected.
incidents.summary: A scammer used deepfake video on a WhatsApp call to impersonate a retired man's former colleague in Kozhikode and get money from him.
incidents.quote: The scammer used deepfake technology to create a video call in which the impersonator's face and voice matched the victim's former colleague.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Hindustan Times has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.
